name: Very Merrytime Roasted Carrot, Yellow & Red Beet Salad with Orange Dressing (Citrus Avoid)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
whyItWorks: Flagged as a strict citrus-avoid dish on the Holiday menu due to the orange vinaigrette and orange zest/segments.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid due to the orange dressing; if you want roasted beets and carrots, ask your server for plain steamed carrots and roasted beets with olive oil only.
watchOuts: CITRUS AVOID: Made with orange dressing and citrus zest
High fiber from root vegetables and greens
